_about: Narration for the Spend Radar demo video. `say` is what the voice reads (spelled for pronunciation); `cap` is the on-screen caption. Every number is from the evidence named in `src`. Scenes are rendered by comp/comp.js; their length follows the narration.

lines.say: Your competitor just doubled their M L team.
lines.cap: Your competitor just doubled their ML team.

lines.say: And you'll find out... next quarter.
lines.cap: And you'll find out… next quarter.

lines.say: Unless Spend Radar finds out first!
lines.cap: Unless Spend Radar finds out first!

lines.say: Meet Spend Radar. An AI agent that reads your books, scans the market, and argues with itself before it tells you anything.
lines.cap: Meet Spend Radar: an AI agent that reads your books, scans the market, and argues with itself before it tells you anything.

lines.say: It plans the job, then reads your budget and invoices.
lines.cap: It plans the job, then reads your budget and invoices.

lines.say: It pings Crust data for real competitor headcount.
lines.cap: It pings Crustdata for real competitor headcount.

lines.say: And Python does all the maths. The model never touches a number in the report.
lines.cap: Python does all the maths. The model never touches a number in the report.

lines.say: When something breaks, like a corrupt PDF or a rate limit, it picks a recovery from a fixed menu.
lines.cap: When something breaks — a corrupt PDF, a rate limit — it picks a recovery from a fixed menu.

lines.say: In one hundred eighty three of three hundred seventy two decisions, it overrode the default rule.
lines.cap: 183 of 372 decisions overrode the default rule.

lines.say: Now the best part.
lines.cap: Now the best part.

lines.say: It claimed Acme's M L team broke policy, a gap of up to five point two eight million dollars a year.
lines.cap: It claimed Acme's ML team broke policy: a gap of up to $5,280,000 a year.

lines.say: Then it tried to prove itself wrong. And it did!
lines.cap: Then it tried to prove itself wrong. And it did!

lines.say: Overturned. That claim never reached the report.
lines.cap: Overturned. That claim never reached the report.

lines.say: We tested it on six companies it was never tuned on.
lines.cap: We tested it on six companies it was never tuned on.

lines.say: Every planted error, caught. Zero false alarms.
lines.cap: Every planted error caught. Zero false alarms.

lines.say: Even when we broke Crust data and the L L M on purpose.
lines.cap: Even when we broke Crustdata and the LLM on purpose.

lines.say: How did we find our bugs? Neat logs. Every call, traced.
lines.cap: How did we find our bugs? neatlogs. Every call, traced.

lines.say: One trace showed the agent throwing away three of its five competitors.
lines.cap: One trace showed the agent throwing away 3 of its 5 competitors.

lines.say: After the fix, it kept all five, and credits dropped from twenty six point six to five point four.
lines.cap: After the fix: all 5 kept, credits 26.6 → 5.4.

lines.say: Entire kept our coding agent's memory. Every commit, linked to the prompt behind it.
lines.cap: Entire kept our coding agent's memory. Every commit linked to the prompt behind it.

lines.say: More than forty checkpoints, all on GitHub.
lines.cap: 40+ checkpoints, all on GitHub.
lines.src: git ls-remote: 47 checkpoint refs at 12:04 IST 11 Oct

lines.say: And C F O dot A I turned our real token costs into a business plan.
lines.cap: And cfo.ai turned our real token costs into a business plan.

lines.say: Under three cents of model per run. But competitor data is about ninety nine percent of the cost.
lines.cap: Under 3¢ of model per run. Competitor data: ~99% of the cost.

lines.say: So we cap fresh data, and the Team tier keeps seventy six point six percent.
lines.cap: Cap fresh data → Team tier margin 76.6%.

lines.say: Spend Radar. Every number has a source.
lines.cap: Spend Radar. Every number has a source.

lines.say: Team Q wep. Hashtag neat hack!
lines.cap: team qwep · #neatHack
